# AdiabaticModeEvolutionCoupler

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A coupler design that gradually transforms the optical mode between waveguides to achieve broadband, fabrication-tolerant coupling. Offers robust, wavelength-insensitive coupling for TCC's reconfigurable topologies, reducing sensitivity to manufacturing variations in 3D stacks.
